lines.t: Dry as a biscuit in here now. Nerys says you brought something honest.
High praise. She once called a sunset 'adequate'.
Welcome to the Mere Hall. Mind your boots — the floor's under three levels of water.
Out-sing a hall Tuner and a sluice opens: down goes the water, up comes the walkway. Two Tuners, two levels.
Nerys waits on her float at the back. Her kin are water, like this hall. Verdant and electric voices ring loud here.
First level's mine. Beat me and I'll pull the sluice. Lose, and you wade home.
Hear that gurgle? That's the first level going down. Onward — try not to slip.
Second sluice, second Tuner. The lake taught me patience. Let's see what it's taught you.
There goes the second level. Nerys will have heard you coming — sound carries over water.
A lake shows you whatever you bring to it. Bring me something honest.
Clear water, clear heart. You've both.
Gale's next. Galewick's winds will carry you, if you let them.
And an Etude — Deluge Beam. A whole lake's worth of argument in one breath. Use it kindly.
Listen. Hear the stones grinding up north? That's the causeway rising. The lake's letting you go.
The Stillmark asked to 'survey' my hall's stone. I told them the lake says no. The lake always says no.
Galewick's past the causeway. Tamsin Galloway will argue with you. Let her. It's how she says hello.
A lake shows you whatever you bring to it. Bring me something honest.
Clear water, clear heart. You've both.
Muddied. Let it settle, then try me again.
Gale's next. Galewick's winds will carry you, if you let them.
